refused.reason: an option that returns people to slavery says so plainly, "return them to slavery": "restore property", "to their owners" or "under the 1850 law" alone is euphemism, and so is sending, turning or driving them back, away or out, or excluding them from the lines (Q6 covers keeping them from freedom as well as return); "property" and "owners" are read only where the label names people, so a railroad restored to its owners passes (SENSITIVE-HISTORY 3.2, the ruling on return, term 4, and Q6; 0046)
